rav-natan-bar-oshaya.name: Rav Natan bar Oshaya
rav-natan-bar-oshaya.bio: Amora cited in the Talmud for a few teachings; here he explains the mishna on dangling wool differently from Reish Lakish.
rav-natan-bar-oshaya.prompt: A scholar in his 50s with a dark beard touched with grey and a plain, precise expression, one hand resting flat as if pressing down a fleece; background of limestone arches and olive trees.
